The '''lava skiff''' was a repulsor vehicle used on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to traverse the lava covering the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface without damage. It was able to seat two [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], and could reach the same speed as an [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]]. A Dark Jedi named Lord Vartonis possessed a Lava Skiff, although he lost it to an anonymous spacer after being killed by the spacer in question in 1 ABY.
